title: nicotiana inodora
intro: Nicotiana inodora, commonly known as the fragrant tobacco plant, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the nightshade family. The health benefits of Nicotiana inodora include its potential to aid in sleep, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Nicotiana inodora include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its calming effects and potential health benefits.
